description:
Flapjack is a vintage-inspired hand drawn font, referencing old shop signs and painted billboards of the early 20th century.  In the same spirit as. those early sign-writers, we drew each letter lovingly by hand… before chopping them up to make something you can use and abuse (we won’t even be mad if you stretch our fonts, promise) 😘

We’d probably use Flapjack for logos, merch, or anywhere else you might look to inject a bit of ✨ vintage flare ✨ into a contemporary brand.
